--- /etc/nuxel/phoc-phone.ini
# Nuxel S10+ phoc configuration (beyond2lte).
#
# This is /usr/share/phosh/phoc.ini for the phone, with the HEADLESS-1 output
# geometry set to the handset's own panel: 1440x3040 at scale 2 => 720x1520
# logical pixels => a 360 CSS-pixel viewport, the same band the UTM VM renders
# the Nuxel launcher in (VM: [output:Virtual-1] mode = 720x1440, scale = 2,
# 360 CSS px).  The VM value is kept for reference below; only the physical
# resolution differs, which the port record documents.
[output:HEADLESS-1]
mode = 720x1520
scale = 2
--- /etc/gtk-3.0/settings.ini
[Settings]
gtk-theme-name=Adwaita-dark
gtk-application-prefer-dark-theme=true
gtk-icon-theme-name=Adwaita
--- /etc/gtk-4.0/settings.ini
[Settings]
gtk-theme-name=Adwaita-dark
gtk-application-prefer-dark-theme=true
gtk-icon-theme-name=Adwaita
--- /etc/systemd/system/nuxel-wayland.service
[Unit]
Description=Nuxel phone Wayland session (phoc headless + Nuxel Home launcher)
# Bounded restarts (mission 16): never spin into a process storm.
StartLimitIntervalSec=60
StartLimitBurst=5
Documentation=file:/usr/share/doc/nuxel/UTM-LAUNCHER-PORT.md
After=nuxel-touch-arm.service seatd.service
Wants=nuxel-touch-arm.service seatd.service
Before=nuxel-wl-fb.service nuxel-fallback.service

[Service]
Type=simple
# phoc from the phone image, wlroots 0.19 headless backend + pixman renderer:
# the only Wayland output this kernel (CONFIG_DRM unset) can offer.
# A31: the libinput backend must be requested explicitly (A29 asked for 'headless'
# alone, so wlroots never even attempted an input backend) and it needs a backend
# session - seatd provides it (LIBSEAT_BACKEND=seatd).  Both were measured as the
# missing link between "sec_ts produces data" and "the compositor sees a finger".
Environment=WLR_BACKENDS=headless,libinput
# A31: the handset has NO VT (/dev/tty0, /sys/class/vtconsole, /proc/consoles all
# absent), so a VT-bound seat can never activate - seatd's seat was measured to
# time out ('backend.c:105 Timeout waiting session to become active') while libseat's
# noop backend satisfies wlroots' session requirement.  Device access is then granted
# by the preloaded shim for /dev/input paths only.
Environment=LIBSEAT_BACKEND=noop
# If the panel node is absent (the handset booted in CHARGER MODE, where sec_ts
# never binds at all - measured A29b/A31) wlroots would otherwise fail the whole
# backend and phoc would restart-loop.  The shim records what it actually found in
# /run/nuxel-libinput-path.state, so 'zero devices' stays visible evidence.
Environment=WLR_LIBINPUT_NO_DEVICES=1
# A31: the udev daemon is masked on this image (it cannot register workers on 4.14
# and forks unboundedly - measured A26 and re-measured this cycle), so libinput's
# udev backend discovers zero devices.  The preloaded shim redirects ONLY libinput's
# discovery step to its path backend and adds the real /dev/input/eventN node that
# carries INPUT_PROP_DIRECT (the panel's sec_touchscreen).  Real evdev, real
# libinput parsing, real wl_touch - no synthesised events.  See
# tools/s10plus/a31/nuxel-libinput-path.c.
Environment=LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/nuxel/libnuxel-libinput-path.so
Environment=WLR_RENDERER=pixman
Environment=WLR_HEADLESS_OUTPUTS=1
Environment=XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/nuxel-wayland
Environment=XDG_SESSION_TYPE=wayland
ExecStartPre=/bin/mkdir -p /run/nuxel-wayland
ExecStartPre=/bin/chmod 700 /run/nuxel-wayland
# PWNAGE-48000 routed the compositor through a GPU-first launcher.  The wrapper
# exports the Mali-G76/panfrost kbase path and falls back to pixman on failure;
# it invokes the EXACT measured phoc command below, so no measured setting is
# lost - only wrapped.
ExecStart=/usr/lib/nuxel/nuxel-wayland-gpu-wrapper.sh
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
--- /etc/systemd/system/nuxel-bridge.service
[Unit]
Description=Nuxel Bridge - PWA to Native Phone Service Mediator
Documentation=https://github.com/nuxel/nuxel/docs/architecture.md
# DEPENDENCY DIRECTION (measured A33): the bridge CALLS the notification hub
# (SendNotification -> org.nuxel.Notifications on the system bus), so the hub must
# be up first. The previous revision had `Before=nuxel-notifications.service`
# here while nuxel-notifications.service had `Before=nuxel-bridge.service`,
# which is a real ordering CYCLE (tools/s10plus/a33/verify-service-graph.py
# failed on it). The hub is the producer, the bridge is the consumer:
#   nuxel-notifications.service -> nuxel-bridge.service
Wants=dbus.service ModemManager.service nuxel-portal.service nuxel-notifications.service
# PWNAGE-32000 (boot regression): network-online.target previously pulled the
# whole launcher chain behind NetworkManager-wait-online.service, which waits
# a full minute (timeout) before multi-user.target reaches the UI.  The bridge
# is a D-Bus mediator and does not need the network to be online to start;
# network connectivity is consumed asynchronously by the apps that need it.
After=dbus.service ModemManager.service nuxel-portal.service nuxel-notifications.service
Before=phosh.service
# Restart-burst bound ([Unit], not [Service]).
StartLimitIntervalSec=120
StartLimitBurst=10

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/nuxel-bridge
# The bridge refuses to answer a PWA whose bridge_version does not match the
# pinned value in pwa/nuxel-common/bridge-version.json; publish it so the pin is
# visible in `systemctl show -p Environment`.
#   NUXEL_BRIDGE_PROTOCOL_VERSION = the pinned PWA<->host contract ("1")
#   NUXEL_BRIDGE_VERSION          = the host implementation version
Environment=NUXEL_BRIDGE_PROTOCOL_VERSION=1
Environment=NUXEL_BRIDGE_VERSION=0.8.1-beta
Environment=NUXEL_PATHS_CONF=/etc/nuxel/paths.conf
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
RestartMaxDelaySec=30

# Security hardening
User=nuxel-bridge
Group=nuxel-bridge
# The portal owns the shared capability store as the graphical `nuxel` user.
# The bridge also persists the grants it brokers, so grant it only group access
# to that one directory rather than running the bridge as root.
SupplementaryGroups=nuxel
ProtectSystem=full
ProtectHome=true
PrivateTmp=true
NoNewPrivileges=true
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
SecureBits=keep-caps
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=true
RestrictRealtime=true
RestrictNamespaces=true
SystemCallArchitectures=native
SystemCallFilter=@system-service @dbus
SystemCallErrorNumber=EPERM
LockPersonality=true
PrivateDevices=true
ProtectKernelTunables=true
ProtectKernelModules=true
ProtectKernelLogs=true
ProtectControlGroups=true
ProtectProc=invisible
ProcSubset=pid
RemoveIPC=true
DevicePolicy=closed
KeyringMode=private
RuntimeDirectory=nuxel-bridge
StateDirectory=nuxel-bridge
CacheDirectory=nuxel-bridge
# Permission grants and the HTTP-bridge token live in the shared Nuxel data dir
# (configs/nuxel/paths.conf: NUXEL_DATA_DIR=/var/lib/nuxel).
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/nuxel /var/log/nuxel

# D-Bus access
# Sockets: D-Bus uses system bus socket, no extra sockets needed

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
--- /etc/systemd/system/nuxel-notifications.service
[Unit]
Description=Nuxel Notification Hub
Documentation=https://nuxel.org/docs/notifications
Wants=dbus.service
After=dbus.service
# The hub is the PRODUCER for the bridge's SendNotification path, so it starts
# first (briq-04b: this direction is what removes the A33 ordering cycle).
Before=nuxel-bridge.service
# Restart-burst bound ([Unit], not [Service]).
StartLimitIntervalSec=120
StartLimitBurst=15

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/nuxel-notifications
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
RestartMaxDelaySec=30
User=nuxel-notifications
Group=nuxel-notifications
# Persist notification history to the canonical single JSON file (briq-07).
# The resolver in notifications.py reads NUXEL_NOTIFICATIONS_FILE (env first,
# then the built-in default), so pin it explicitly to the canonical path.
Environment=NUXEL_NOTIFICATIONS_FILE=/var/lib/nuxel/notifications.json
Environment=NUXEL_NOTIFICATIONS_HISTORY_CAP=200
Environment=NUXEL_PATHS_CONF=/etc/nuxel/paths.conf
Environment=NUXEL_BRIDGE_PROTOCOL_VERSION=1
Environment=NUXEL_BRIDGE_VERSION=0.8.1-beta

# Security hardening
ProtectSystem=full
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes

# Needs D-Bus + data storage
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/nuxel /var/log/nuxel
ReadOnlyPaths=/etc/dbus-1

[Install]
# NOTE: this is a SYSTEM service on the system bus; graphical-session.target is
# a USER target and enabling a system unit there is a no-op.  Fixed to the real
# target so `systemctl enable` actually starts it.
WantedBy=multi-user.target
